executionNotes: Most SQLite tests set DATABASE_URL empty and DATABASE_PATH before dynamic imports of db/repositories; these are isolated temp DBs, not production evidence.

Static imports before environment setup are a risk when the imported module transitively imports db/config. The PostgreSQL tests statically import query-only repository/service functions, while most SQLite repository imports are dynamic after env setup. This is a source-level finding, not runtime proof.

battle-awareness-narration-events-postgres, battle-awareness-narration-reservation-postgres, and battle-awareness-postgres skip when AWARENESS_POSTGRES_TEST_URL is absent and require loopback database kshiai_awareness_test when present. The required PG harness is the disposable loopback kshiai_awareness_test; no remote/production PG URL is acceptable.
battle-lifecycle-storage and cutover-control have optional VT110/VT104 PostgreSQL harnesses that create/drop disposable databases; they must be bounded to owner-approved loopback/disposable targets.
